Name: Jehoiada, Leader of Aaronites
Summary: Leader of the Aaronites who came to David at Hebron, with three thousand and seven hundred with him.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:27: Leader of the Aaronites who came to David at Hebron, with three thousand and seven hundred with him.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehoiada in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
